messages:
carmen: quick check — today's release train is still set for 14:00 PT. we have three lanes: api, infra, web. who is owning infra lane (migrations + kv config)?
leo: i can take infra lane. planning to kick at 14:10 PT after the flag flip. will run smoke + metrics check.
jun: thanks leo. note the migration adds a background migration that runs for ~3m, so we should allow a 5m buffer before web lane.
amanda: i'll flip the feature flag at 14:05 PT as planned. please confirm rollback command and smoke checklist.
leo: rollback cmd is `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/infra-service --to-revision=2` (we keep last-known-good as rev 2). smoke checklist: 1) health endpoints green 2) 95p latency under 200ms 3) KV read/write basic flow.
jun: can we add a quick synthetic that hits /auth/login to validate session caching? i can wire it to smoke-job if leo wants.
leo: yes please — jun, add that to the smoke job and post the URL. i'll monitor traces.
amanda: FYI i'll post once flag is flipped, then ping @leo @jun to start canary.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window opened for release-train-05 (14:00 PT). lane order: api -> infra -> web. canary window: 10m per lane.
carmen: re-order request: api contains a hotfix that needs to go before infra. can we do api first at 14:00, then infra 14:10, web 14:25?
leo: that works. i'll be ready at 14:10. jun, amanda — sync on canary timing please.
jun: 14:10 works for me, will start synthetic at +2m after infra deploy completes.
amanda: copy. i'll watch metrics and flip flags if we hit regression. if anything looks off i'll trigger rollback and notify #incidents.
leo: for rollback readiness, i've staged a dataplane switch and we have capacity on previous canary. rollback estimate ~6m to full rollback and verification.
carmen: perfect. one more ask: add a short post-deploy note in the release doc with canary start/end times + perf deltas. i'll collect and archive.
jun: note to self — set tracer sampling to 0.2 for noisy endpoints during canary to save quota.
amanda: 14:05 flipping flag now :rocket:
leo: seeing deploy artifact being pushed. starting infra rollout in ~2m.
deploy-bot: infra-service rollout started by leo at 1743210220. logs: https://ci.redwood/infra/1743210220
leo: infra rollout succeeded. running smoke suite now.
jun: synthetic /auth/login returned 200 within 120ms. KV tests pass.
amanda: metrics look stable. 95p latency 180ms -> within threshold. ok to proceed to web at 14:25.
carmen: thanks everyone. i'll mark train as green and update the release doc. :white_check_mark:
